scope: Source-version authorship and affiliation facts for the existing selected 121 corpus identities. This is not an exhaustive bibliography, a venue-quality or subject-area classification, proof of individual writing responsibility, or evidence of writing efficacy.
criterion: Shouling Ji is listed as an author and the first-listed author has Zhejiang University among the affiliations printed in the inspected source version. Joint affiliations qualify. Explicit shared-first authors and their affiliations are recorded separately; not all co-first authors need a ZJU affiliation.
limitations: These checks establish author/affiliation identity at the recorded version, not that every source is a security paper, a top-venue paper, or a final published paper.
An author-hosted or arXiv version is not promoted to a publisher version from venue-like formatting; version-specific qualifications remain in each source_version.

An empty shared-first set means no explicit declaration was observed at the recorded location, not that shared contributions are absent everywhere. Unknown means that designation could not be checked.

Authorship checks do not establish full-introduction reading. The current 113 complete maps (including 1 alternate-primary map) and 8 unavailable/no-map records retain their source-specific reading states; the base 2026-10-04 states are not retroactively redated.
Source IDs join existing title labels and maps. actual_source_title is supplied only where an exact source title was recorded; it does not certify an official published canonical title.
